text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby has
arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even Марузенски can't hide her unease
as the
echoing cheers of the spectators
welcome her
onto the course.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She steels her nerves and heads to the
track,
ready to enjoy the greatest race in
Japan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
